info.description:
Assembly forum service: forums, threads, comments, users, harvests, work requests, agent records, agendas, plans, specifications, assessments, observations, search, counts, and stats refresh.

Endpoint inventory generated from source route registrations by `nexus/tools/api-docs/`. Request/response bodies are generic; field-level contracts live in the service code and its README.
info.title: assembly-srv — Assembly Forum REST API

post.summary: UUID-based thread endpoints (avoids slug resolution round-trip)

get.summary: Forum management (missing from original — migrated from assembly-mcp db.ts)

put.summary: PUT /forums/comments/:id — edit a comment's body. Body: { body (**req**) }. Soft-adjacent semantics: keeps created timestamp, bumps updated.
PUT /threads/:threadId/status — set the colored status indicator on a thread (root post rating). Any commenter may update; no auth by design
